project_type: Go backend (Gin + GORM) with React frontend (React Router, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)
build_system: go build for backend, pnpm for frontend (web/ directory). Makefile present.
test_framework: No dedicated test runner found; project relies on go build/vet and TypeScript type checking
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go && go build ./... && cd web && pnpm build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go && go vet ./... && cd web && pnpm typecheck
verification_instructions: 1. Run go build ./... to confirm backend compiles. 2. Run go vet ./... to confirm no issues. 3. cd web && pnpm typecheck (or pnpm build) to confirm frontend compiles.
snapshot_or_generated_files: web/lib/auth/permissions.generated.ts is generated by `go run ./cmd/generator/permissions` but we will update it manually since we cannot run the generator in this environment.
setup_instructions: Backend: go build ./... in root. Frontend: cd web && pnpm install && pnpm build.
environment_constraints: Network may be limited. Cannot run the full application (needs MySQL). Validate via compilation only.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns exactly. Code style is very consistent across repository, service, handler layers.
key_patterns: Backend: Repository pattern (internal/repositories/), Service pattern (internal/services/), Admin handlers (internal/handlers/admin/), API handlers (internal/handlers/api/), Cache (internal/cache/), Migrations (migrations/), Permissions (internal/permissions/permissions.go), Router (internal/server/router.go). Frontend: DashboardDataPage config-driven CRUD pages (web/app/routes/dashboard.*.tsx), i18n in web/lib/i18n/messages/{en-US,zh-CN}.ts, permissions in web/lib/auth/permissions.generated.ts, dashboard sidebar in web/components/dashboard/app-sidebar.tsx, frontend sidebar in web/components/topic/topics-nav-content.tsx.
directory_structure: Root: Go app (main.go, cmd/, internal/, migrations/). internal/: models, repositories, services, handlers/{admin,api}, cache, permissions, server, middleware, pkg. web/: React app with app/routes/ for pages, components/ for UI, lib/ for utilities/api/i18n/auth.
